questions.stem: A 55-year-old man presents to the emergency department with sudden chest pain radiating to his left arm and jaw. His electrocardiogram shows ST-segment elevation, and laboratory studies indicate elevated cardiac biomarkers. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management for this patient?

options.label: D
options.text: Medical management with antiplatelet and anticoagulant therapy
